title: Introduction
summary: Introduces Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD) based similarity search, its challenges, and the focus on optimizing the refinement phase.

title: Preliminaries
summary: Defines EMD formally, presents the min‑cost flow formulation, and introduces the filter‑and‑refinement framework.

sub_nodes.title: Computing the EMD
sub_nodes.summary: Describes how EMD can be computed via linear programming and successive shortest path (SSP) algorithms.

sub_nodes.title: Filter‑and‑Refinement Framework
sub_nodes.summary: Explains the two‑phase search process, definitions of feasible edges, and the role of lower‑bound filters.

title: Scaling up SSP
summary: Introduces the Simplified Incremental Algorithm (SIA) for incremental graph construction and its integration with SSP.

title: Boosting the Refinement Phase
summary: Presents two novel techniques—Progressive Bounding (PB) and Dynamic Refinement Ordering (DRO)—to accelerate the refinement stage.

sub_nodes.title: Analysis of EMD Calculation
sub_nodes.summary: Analyzes the runtime behavior of SIA and motivates early termination of EMD computation.

sub_nodes.title: Progressive Bounding
sub_nodes.summary: Defines a running lower bound (emd−) that tightens during SIA and enables early pruning of candidates.

sub_nodes.title: Sensitivity to Refinement Order
sub_nodes.summary: Discusses how the order of candidate processing affects overall query cost and introduces lemmas supporting PB.

sub_nodes.title: Dynamic Refinement Ordering
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the DRO algorithm that dynamically reorders candidates based on emd− to improve pruning efficiency.

sub_nodes.title: Running Upper Bound
sub_nodes.summary: Introduces emd+ as a running upper bound, computed via a greedy maximum‑flow approach, to further tighten pruning.

title: Experimental Evaluation
summary: Details the experimental setup, datasets, and compares various EMD computation methods and the proposed PB/DRO techniques.

sub_nodes.title: Performance Improvement
sub_nodes.summary: Presents query‑time results showing SIA’s superiority and the additional gains from PB and DRO.

sub_nodes.title: Scalability Experiments
sub_nodes.summary: Evaluates how PB and DRO scale with dataset size and k, demonstrating near‑optimal performance.

title: Related Work
summary: Reviews prior research on EMD‑based similarity search, filtering techniques, and refinement methods.

title: Conclusion
summary: Summarizes contributions, highlights the effectiveness of PB and DRO, and outlines future research directions.

title: Parameter Tuning in DRO
summary: Analyzes the impact of two sensitive parameters in DRO: the maximum number of concurrently refined objects (size of PL) and the function used to prioritize objects.

title: Acknowledgment
summary: Acknowledges funding sources, grants, and individuals who contributed code and feedback.

title: References
summary: Lists cited works covering EMD theory, applications, approximation algorithms, and related indexing techniques.
